verdict.rationale: Formant's own materials say users can ask their fleet questions in plain language and receive ML-driven task recommendations. The analytics docs also mention an AI assistant for building dashboards, which points to in-product AI insights and suggestions. The evidence is mostly a marketing tagline plus one brief docs mention, so depth and behavior are unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights the AI assistant generates from data, how recommendations are produced and surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask your fleet what's happening in plain language and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations — with people approving what happens next.
Using built-in visualizations, custom SQL queries, or our AI assistant, you can build a rich dashboard for your devices.
